name: Amoeboid Changeling — every creature type is real subtypes
notes: Memory: project_all_creature_types_except_2026-04-28 and project_changeling_layer4_effect_2026-04-26. Changeling must be a Layer 4 ADD_TYPE effect that materialises every creature type, so Elvish Archdruid's 'Other Elf creatures you control' lord applies to it. A Bear-only Grizzly Bears is not an Elf.
